en-us.kor_L01:
$kanon.name$ looks up from her paperwork as if she'd been expecting $self.name$.
"Made up your mind?"
She pulls out a contract and slides it across the desk.
"Miyama Pictures. Rent plus maintenance, 460,000 a month. To rent it, the first month gets paid now, billed monthly after that. The keys and the place are yours to run."
"One more thing — once you have a studio of your own, that actress list of mine goes to you as well. Introductions, evaluations — all of that comes once you're properly in the business."
en-us.kor_Q01_op1_tooltip: The first month's rent will be deducted from the Miyama household's funds
en-us.kor_L_accept:
$kanon.name$ puts away the transfer receipt and sets a keyring down on the desk.
"From today, Miyama Pictures is yours to run. Utilities, staff, rent — all your business now."
"I'll have the list sent over. Do good work — don't tarnish the name."

en-us.kor_L_decline: "No rush. The place stays empty; the keys stay with me."
